model_output.verdict: A construction project manager with a clear portfolio and results, though one project could show more of how it got there.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for construction project management! At Capitol Builders, you show the value and number of projects you run, the trades you manage, and results on schedule and change orders. A recruiter can quickly see the work you've handled.

The grocery store line is especially memorable: a $14M build delivered three weeks early. Your move from Assistant Project Manager to Project Manager also tells a clear story, and Experience is in the right place above Education.
Let's add what you did to get the grocery store build over the line early. Your resume isn't likely to be what stands between you and a call back; competition for the particular job matters too.

cards.line: - Delivered a $14M grocery store build 3 weeks ahead of schedule in 2024
cards.cannot_tell: The early finish stands out, but a recruiter can't tell what you did to get there. Your part in the schedule would make this accomplishment even stronger.
cards.example: Delivered a $14M grocery store build 3 weeks ahead of schedule in 2024 by [your contribution to the schedule]
cards.question: What did you do that helped the grocery store build finish early?

cards.line: - Run 4 to 6 concurrent tenant-improvement projects worth $1M to $8M each
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It puts the number of concurrent projects and their value right next to the work you run, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess how big the job is.

cards.line: - Manage subcontractor bids and buyout for 20 to 30 trades per project
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above Project Manager, a recruiter will also look for how you direct people or decisions across projects. If that's part of your job, add it alongside the trade management.
cards.example: Manage subcontractor bids and buyout for 20 to 30 trades per project, and direct [team or cross-project responsibility]
cards.question: What people or decisions do you direct across projects?

cards.line: - Kept change orders under 3% of contract value across 2024 and 2025 projects
cards.cannot_tell: This gives a recruiter a concrete result across projects. Consider moving it above the bids and buyout line so that result gets seen sooner.

fit.why: Your headline and current role both point to construction project management for commercial projects.
fit.level: Project manager, running 4 to 6 concurrent projects
